system.description: Raised within a temple, monastery, shrine, religious family, or institution whose doctrine and observances shaped daily life.

legacy.name: Sacred Trust
legacy.text: The first time each adventure you would take Influence Damage, you may reduce that damage to 0. This protection does not prevent Influence Breach.

familiarity.name: Sacred Practice
familiarity.text: You recognize common symbols, rituals, offices, doctrinal divisions, and forms of address used by established religious institutions. You can identify when a public observance differs from accepted practice, though you do not automatically know the reason.
